name: The Moonsilver Blade
summary: In Silverpine Forest, Trevan Rol awaits the blade that will complete his work before he faces a beast.

sections.title: The Blade
sections.body: Ott thanks you for the chance to help and asks you to carry his gratitude to Trevan. You bring Ott's Masterwork back to Trevan Rol in Silverpine Forest.

sections.title: Trevan's Approval
sections.body: Trevan Rol examines the blade and approves of Ott's work. Only the beast remains. When you are ready, he directs you to speak with Lumina.

faq.answer: Ott made Ott's Masterwork and sent it with you to Trevan Rol.
Trevan Rol receives and inspects Ott's Masterwork in Silverpine Forest.

faq.q: Where do I bring the blade?
faq.answer: Bring Ott's Masterwork to Trevan Rol in Silverpine Forest.

faq.q: What does Trevan think of the blade?
faq.answer: Trevan Rol inspects the blade and says it will do nicely.

faq.q: Who should I speak with after Trevan?
faq.answer: When you are ready, Trevan Rol directs you to speak with Lumina.

attribution: In-game quest text: The Moonsilver Blade
